note: Shared-rule candidates found while authoring sync_protocol.logic.json (and reused by hashgraph_events). Same shape as data/logic_rules.json entries; inlined in the mapping files until the integrator merges them.

entries.name: Sync — two units share a strong region
entries.description: hex_distance(a.tile, b.tile) <= sync_region_tiers.tiers[0].strong_radius_tiles. Used by sync_region_tiers (membership, promotion, strong_region_members), sync_handshake_per_action (actor_in_strong_region), evt_action_commit (action_in_strong_region). Pass tiles as {q,r}.

entries.name: Sync — tier name for a hex distance
entries.description: strong when dist <= strong radius, reachable when dist <= reach, far otherwise (peer.mjs tierOf). Used by sync_region_tiers.tier_of_peer and the UI roster.

entries.name: Handshake — every expected member sent its envelope
entries.description: subset_of(expected, seen). Used by sync_handshake_per_action.phase_may_advance, evt_action_commit.all_committed, evt_instant.window_closed, evt_state_hash.all_reveals_in_or_expired, evt_genesis / evt_merge finality (signers), evt_join.accepted.

entries.name: Handshake — silent member is resolved as Empty Posture
entries.description: 'EP' once elapsed_s >= handshake_timeout_s (sync_region_tiers.failure_mode / rule_6), null while the window is open. Used by sync_handshake_per_action and evt_action_commit.

entries.name: Radicle — push interval index
entries.description: floor(unix_time / radicle_push_interval_s). Used by sync_radicle_push (interval_index, next_push_at_s, fallback_deadline_s, is_elected_pusher_or_fallback) and evt_radicle_push.

entries.name: Radicle — artefact path under ActiveDimensions/<DimensionName>/
entries.description: cat('ActiveDimensions/', dimension_name, '/', rest). Used by sync_radicle_push (door_path, dimension_descriptor_path, runtime_door_path), evt_radicle_push.commit_path, session_dimension_descriptor.descriptor_path, session_door.door_path, governance_branch_layout.dimension_branch_name.

entries.name: Sync — the Dimension turn is the max seen
entries.description: max(mine, max_of(peers' turns)). Used by sync_turn_commit.dimension_turn, evt_turn_commit.dimension_turn, sync_divergence_merge.merged_turn, evt_merge.turn_adopted, sync_radicle_push.merged_dimension_turn, session_dimension_descriptor.merged_turn.
